    static final int M2 = 1000000007;
    static final int MAX_SIZE = 2000000;
    static final int LIMIT = 1000000;
    static long n_value, c_value;
    static int total_count, final_answer, limit_depth;
    static int[] pw_array = new int[9];
    static int[] sum_array = new int[9];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
            data_vectors[i] = new ArrayList<>();

    static int subtract_mod(int x, int y, int m) {
        return (x - y < 0) ? x - y + m : x - y;
    }

    static int add_mod(int x, int y, int m) {
        return (x + y >= m) ? x + y - m : x + y;

            sum_array[depth - 1] = add_mod(sum_array[depth - 1], x, M2);
        }
        if (depth > 6) return;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
            generate(depth + 1, val * 10 + i);
        }

    static void compute(int depth, long current) {
        if (current > n_value) return;
        if (depth > 1) {
            if (10L * current * LIMIT > n_value && (current + 1) * LIMIT - 1 <= n_value) {

        }
        int start = (depth == 1) ? 1 : 0;
        for (int i = start; i <= 9; i++) {

        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n_value = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        pw_array[0] = 1;

        System.out.println(final_answer);
